# Tabler for Sân Nhà

Version: @tabler/core 1.4.0. Upstream: https://github.com/tabler/tabler
Official documentation: https://docs.tabler.io/ui/getting-started
CSS download: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/css/tabler.min.css
SHA-256: 7ef750bd10546a695d0b12767ad8048bd8f3ec5de7daefb1067f9d0daa3d1c9a

License: MIT. LICENSE is copied from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tabler/tabler/dev/LICENSE (retrieved 2026-11-04). The distributed CSS retains its own 2018–2025 Tabler Authors and codecalm.net Paweł Kuna copyright notices.

Only CSS is bundled: Tabler already includes Bootstrap's styles, replacing the bootstrap.min.css link. Existing local JavaScript controls menus, forms, gallery, QR and chat. No Tabler JS, tracking, demo datasets, remote fonts or demo photos are loaded. The CSS source map is not required at runtime.

Application adaptation: /css/template-redesign.css. Existing component CSS remains for application-specific layouts. Assets are served locally under /vendor/tabler/.
